about: Candidate seed studies proposed by the assistant for the critical-review pilot, from its own knowledge. They are NOT the result of a systematic search and NOT a screening decision. Each title, author and year below is what the assistant believes; none counts as a bibliographic fact until scripts/pilot/verify_seeds.py has matched it to a Crossref record. The researcher decides what to screen in.
